name: Lyuba House Manager
overview: The management company of a brand-new apartment complex is clearly failing to fulfill its responsibilities. A proactive resident, Lyubov, a mother of two who moved into the apartment after a divorce, takes matters into her own fragile hands, hoping to make things better for everyone. However, instead of support or gratitude from the residents, the self-proclaimed manager is met with condemnation. But Lyuba is not used to despair or giving up, and now the chat room of the building's residents is not only on her phone, but completely and utterly in her life.
